asr_text: Your 11 labs voice clone sounds noisy or unstable. It's the recording. The eye mimics everything, speed, accent, breathing noise, even mouth clicks. It copies the performance too. Talk in a monotone, get a monotone. Mixing animated and subdue delivery can make the clone unstable. So one speaker, no echo or noise, consistent tone, no long gaps. Use a pop filter about two fists from the microphone. Save this and watch the full lesson in episode 10.
